column1: # ZAP Baseline Scan Rules for MMS Platform
# Format: rule-id<TAB>IGNORE|WARN|FAIL<TAB>description
# HIGH findings always FAIL unless explicitly suppressed here.
# WARN rules do not fail the build (workflow uses cmd_options: '-I').
# IGNORE rules are not reported at all.
# Only suppress alerts that have been reviewed and accepted for this API context.
# ── Header findings (REST/JSON API — browser-centric headers N/A) ─────────────
# 10015 - Incomplete or No Cache-control Header Set
# API responses are not cached by browsers; this header is irrelevant for JSON APIs.

column3: Incomplete or No Cache-control Header Set

column1: # 10049 - Storable and Cacheable Content
# ZAP flags 404 responses on /, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml as cacheable.
# These paths return intentional 404s — the API has no root document to serve.
# 10016 - Web Browser XSS Protection Not Enabled
# Helmet intentionally sets X-XSS-Protection: 0 (modern browser guidance).

column3: Web Browser XSS Protection Not Enabled

column1: # 10020 - Missing Anti-clickjacking Header
# Helmet sets both X-Frame-Options: DENY and CSP frame-ancestors: none.
# ZAP may still flag if it evaluates only one of these mechanisms.
# 10021 - X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing
# Helmet sets noSniff: true on all responses.
# 10035 - Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set
# HSTS is set by Helmet (maxAge 1yr, includeSubDomains, preload).
# ZAP flags it on HTTP test environments since HSTS is technically HTTPS-only.
# 10036 - Server Leaks Version Information via "Server" HTTP Response Header
# Helmet removes/obscures this; may still appear from Node.js/Express defaults.
# 10055 - Content Security Policy (CSP) Scanner
# Helmet sets a strict CSP. ZAP may warn on 'unsafe-inline' in styleSrc,
# which is an accepted tradeoff for API responses (no browser rendering).
# 10063 - Permissions Policy Header Not Set
# REST API — no browser features (camera, mic, geolocation) are used.
# This header is only relevant for browser-rendered pages.
# 10096 - Timestamp Disclosure
# /health endpoint intentionally includes an ISO-8601 timestamp.
# No epoch timestamps that could be used for timing attacks.
# 10109 - Modern Web Application
# ZAP info-level finding for JSON APIs. Not a security issue.
# 10110 - Dangerous JS Functions
# False positives from minified Node.js dependencies in stack traces or error bodies.
# ── Cookie findings (test environment uses HTTP, not HTTPS) ──────────────────
# 10011 - Cookie Without Secure Flag
# Auth cookies (refresh tokens, session IDs) lack the Secure flag on HTTP test env.
# Production runs behind TLS termination — Secure flag enforced at load balancer.
# 10054 - Cookie Without SameSite Attribute
# Express session/auth cookies default to no SameSite. CORS policy restricts
# cross-origin requests. Accepted for test environment.
# 90033 - Loosely Scoped Cookie
# Test-env cookies may not have domain restrictions. Production uses strict domain.
# ── Information disclosure (intentional or non-sensitive) ────────────────────
# 10027 - Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments
# Build artifacts may contain source-map comments. Not exploitable via API.
# 10094 - Base64 Disclosure
# JWT tokens in Authorization headers and responses are Base64URL-encoded by design.
# 10098 - Cross-Domain Misconfiguration
# CORS is explicitly configured via CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var.
# ZAP may flag permissive wildcard patterns during baseline spider phase.
# ── Alerts irrelevant for a JSON REST API ────────────────────────────────────
# 90003 - Sub Resource Integrity Attribute Missing
# API returns JSON — no external CSS/JS resources loaded via HTML.
# 10108 - Reverse Tabnabbing
# API returns JSON — no HTML with target="_blank" anchor tags.
# 10017 - Cross-Domain JavaScript Source File Inclusion
# API serves no HTML pages that include external JavaScript.
# 40040 - CORS Misconfiguration - Wildcard Origin
# CORS origin validation is enforced via allowlist in createCorsMiddleware().
# ZAP's spider requests (no Origin header) are permitted by design.
